label: FHL payroll, including benefits
basis_note: Estimated from a staff roster priced at local wages for each occupation, plus university benefit rates
source: model/build/inputs.csv row OPS_LI; model/operations/operations_inputs.csv row OPS_LABOR_INCOME; B_LABOR draws

label: FHL purchases other than payroll
basis_note: Estimated operating spending less payroll and scholarships
source: model/build/inputs.csv row OPS_PURCH; model/operations/operations_inputs.csv row OPS_PURCHASES; OPS_TOTAL draws, OPS_LABOR_INCOME draws, SCHOLARSHIPS; floor from NP_ITEMIZED_TOTAL

label: Scholarships (left out of spending as a transfer)
source: model/build/inputs.csv row OPS_SCHOL; model/operations/operations_inputs.csv row OPS_TRANSFERS; https://web.archive.org/web/20250103200108/https://fhl.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/17/2024/11/2024IntTidings.pdf

label: Direct FHL jobs (annual-average full-time equivalents)
basis_note: Year-round staff plus seasonal staff, summer instructors and teaching assistants for the months they work
source: model/build/inputs.csv row OPS_JOBS; model/operations/operations_inputs.csv rows B_FTE_YEARROUND, R15-R19

label: Research award dollars for work at FHL each year, gross (university overhead included)
basis_note: Low: counted awards only. Central and high add assumed shares of awards carried out partly at FHL or held by scientists based there
source: model/build/inputs.csv row RES_GROSS; model/research_construction/research_summary.csv avg_uw_fy2022_2024 research (central and high scenarios); model/research_construction/research_by_uw_fy.csv FY2019

label: Share of research award dollars spent as direct costs (the rest is university overhead)
basis_note: From the UW Office of Research report for fiscal 2019
source: model/build/inputs.csv row RES_DIRECT_SHARE; research module notes; UW Office of Research FY2019 report https://research.washington.edu/research/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/ARFY2019_v8.pdf

label: Students' spending off the station in San Juan County
basis_note: Students from outside the county: people times days times spending a day
source: model/build/inputs.csv rows U_AUTUMN_CTY, U_MARBIO_CTY, U_REU_CTY, U_SPRING_CTY, U_SUMMER_CTY (summed)

label: Visitors' spending off the station in San Juan County
basis_note: Researchers, workshop participants, instructors, Whiteley Center scholars and groups from outside the county
source: model/build/inputs.csv rows U_GROUPS_CTY, U_INSTRUCTORS_CTY, U_RESEARCHERS_CTY, U_WHITELEY_CTY, U_WORKSHOP_CTY (summed)

label: Construction spending, 2015–2024 (one-time total)
basis_note: Fernald Laboratory basement, sewer lift station, Lab 2 genomics laboratory and a share of state minor works

label: Share of FHL spending that came from donors
basis_note: FHL's own estimate, published in March 2023, of the money it spends each year (“almost 25%”); the range is an assumption
source: model/build/inputs.csv row DONOR_SHARE; model/operations/operations_inputs.csv row DONOR_SHARE_2022; https://web.archive.org/web/20240118033054/https://fhl.uw.edu/about/news-and-events/2023/03/21/tide-bite-april-2023/

label: Share of user spending by people from outside Washington
basis_note: From the student and visitor estimates

label: Household-spending effect per dollar of labor income, Washington
unit: dollars of output per dollar of labor income
basis_note: Calibrated to the IMPLAN study of the University of Washington's research enterprise. The range is the one used in the simulations; the uncalibrated state table (1.53) is used only as an alternative model
source: model/build/inputs.csv row WA_IND_K; Parker Strategy Group (2024) UW Economic Impact Report FY23 (IMPLAN), pp. 6-11, https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/18/2024/10/29155253/PSG-UW-Economic-Impact-Report.pdf p. 9 (UW research enterprise table); WWU CEBR (Dec 2024) Washington State Ferry System Economic Impact Study, Tables 1, 4, 24, https://cbe.wwu.edu/sites/cbe.wwu.edu/files/2025-01/WWU%20Ferry%20Study%20Full%20Report.pdf Tables 1-2; OFM 2012 closure (this model)

label: Household-spending effect per dollar of labor income, San Juan County
unit: dollars of output per dollar of labor income
basis_note: Calibrated to the IMPLAN study of the Friday Harbor ferry route. The range is the one used in the simulations; the uncalibrated county tables (0.19 and 0.75) are used only as alternative models
source: model/build/inputs.csv row SJC_IND_K; WWU CEBR (Dec 2024) Washington State Ferry System Economic Impact Study, Tables 1, 4, 24, https://cbe.wwu.edu/sites/cbe.wwu.edu/files/2025-01/WWU%20Ferry%20Study%20Full%20Report.pdf Table 24 (Route 80, San Juan County); WWU CEBR San Juan County profile 2025, https://cbe.wwu.edu/sites/cbe.wwu.edu/files/2025-10/San%20Juan%20profile_2025_FINAL.pdf (people_and_local/san_juan_county_context.csv); FLQ closures (this model)

label: State and local taxes per dollar of output
basis_note: Ratios from the University of Washington's IMPLAN study
source: model/build/inputs.csv row TAX_OUT; model/multipliers/multipliers.csv; Parker Strategy Group (2024) UW Economic Impact Report FY23 (IMPLAN), pp. 6, 8, 9, 11 https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/18/2024/10/29155253/PSG-UW-Economic-Impact-Report.pdf
